title: He Drifted Across the Pacific for 438 Days and Survived

scenes.text: A fisherman drifted across the Pacific for 438 days and survived.
In November 2012, he left Mexico on a fishing trip.
A storm left his boat adrift in the open ocean.
For 438 days, he caught fish with his bare hands.
He ate seabirds and turtles, and drank rain when it came.
He drifted an estimated 5,500 to 6,700 miles.
In January 2014, he washed ashore in the Marshall Islands.

description:
A fisherman drifted across the Pacific for 438 days.
He survived on fish, birds, turtles and rainwater, and washed ashore in the Marshall Islands in January 2014.
Could you last a week?
first_comment: 438 days at sea. How long do you think you'd last?
